ex.en: She works as a financial advisor at a bank.
ex.zh: 她在銀行擔任理財顧問。

ex.en: The president met with his advisors this morning.
ex.zh: 總裁今天早上和他的顧問們開會。

advisor.en: a person whose job is to give expert advice

ex.en: My academic advisor helped me choose my courses.
ex.zh: 我的指導老師幫我選課。

ex.en: I need to talk to my thesis advisor.
ex.zh: 我需要跟我的論文指導教授談談。

advisor.en: a teacher who helps students with their studies

ex.en: Who is the Administrative Assistant?
ex.zh: 誰是行政助理？

ex.en: She handles most of the administrative work.
ex.zh: 大部分的行政工作都由她處理。

ex.en: There is an administrative fee of 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 需另收一百元的行政手續費。

administrative.en: of the work of running an organization

ex.en: Please contact the system administrator.
ex.zh: 請聯絡系統管理員。

ex.en: She works as a school administrator.
ex.zh: 她在學校擔任行政人員。

administrator.en: a person who helps run an organization or system

adhere.zh: adhere to：遵守、堅持（規定、計畫）

ex.en: He adhered to the original plan.
ex.zh: 他堅持原本的計畫。

ex.en: All staff must adhere to the safety rules.
ex.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守安全規定。

adhere.en: to keep following a rule, plan or belief

ex.en: The label won't adhere to wet surfaces.
ex.zh: 標籤黏不上潮濕的表面。

ex.en: This tape adheres well to glass.
ex.zh: 這種膠帶黏在玻璃上很牢。

adhere.en: to stick firmly to a surface

ex.en: This job offers good opportunities for career advancement.
ex.zh: 這份工作提供很好的升遷機會。

ex.en: There's little room for advancement here.
ex.zh: 這裡沒什麼升遷空間。

advancement.en: the act of moving to a better or higher position

ex.en: Advancements in technology have changed how we work.
ex.zh: 科技的進步改變了我們的工作方式。

ex.en: The advancement of science takes time.
ex.zh: 科學的進步需要時間。

advertiser.zh: 廣告主、刊登廣告的客戶

ex.en: Advertisers want to reach young consumers.
ex.zh: 廣告主想觸及年輕消費者。

ex.en: The magazine lost several major advertisers.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌失去了好幾個大廣告客戶。

advertiser.en: a person or company that pays to tell the public about a product

ex.en: She sits on the company's advisory board.
ex.zh: 她是公司顧問委員會的成員。

ex.en: The committee plays an advisory role.
ex.zh: 這個委員會扮演諮詢的角色。

advisory.en: giving advice and not making the final decision

ex.en: The government issued a travel advisory for the region.
ex.zh: 政府對該地區發布了旅遊警示。

ex.en: A heat advisory is in effect today.
ex.zh: 今天發布了高溫特報。

advisory.en: an official notice that gives a warning or information

ex.en: The fund is administered by a bank.
ex.zh: 這筆基金由一家銀行管理。

ex.en: She administers the company's training program.
ex.zh: 她負責管理公司的培訓計畫。

administer.en: to manage or organize the work of something

ex.en: The doctor administered medicine to the patient.
ex.zh: 醫生給病人用了藥。

ex.en: The medication should be administered topically.
ex.zh: 此藥應局部外用。

ex.en: The test will be administered next Monday.
ex.zh: 測驗將於下週一舉行。

administer.en: to give a medicine or carry out a test

ex.en: Additionally, the hotel offers free breakfast.
ex.zh: 此外，飯店還提供免費早餐。

ex.en: Additionally, please submit a copy of your ID.
ex.zh: 另外，請繳交一份身分證影本。

additionally.en: used to add one more thing to what has been said

adapter.zh: 轉接頭、轉接器；（電源）變壓器

ex.en: You'll need a power adapter for your trip to Europe.
ex.zh: 去歐洲旅行你會需要電源轉接頭。

ex.en: I forgot my laptop adapter at home.
ex.zh: 我把筆電的變壓器忘在家裡了。

adapter.en: a device that lets plugs or machines work together

ex.en: It is advisable to book your tickets in advance.
ex.zh: 建議提早訂票。

ex.en: Wearing a mask in crowded places is advisable.
ex.zh: 在人多的地方最好戴口罩。

ex.en: The adoption of new technology improved productivity.
ex.zh: 採用新技術提升了生產力。

ex.en: The board voted for the adoption of the plan.
ex.zh: 董事會投票通過採用這項計畫。

adoption.en: the act of starting to use an idea or method

ex.en: They are thinking about adoption.
ex.zh: 他們在考慮領養小孩。

ex.en: The dog is available for adoption.
ex.zh: 這隻狗開放領養。

adoption.en: the act of legally taking a child into your family

ex.en: The drug has no adverse side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥沒有不良副作用。

ex.en: Bad weather had an adverse effect on sales.
ex.zh: 惡劣天氣對銷售造成不利影響。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to adverse weather.
ex.zh: 班機因天候不佳而延誤。

ex.en: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
ex.zh: 能用愚蠢解釋的事，就別歸咎於惡意。

ex.en: Make sure the room is adequately ventilated.
ex.zh: 務必確保房間充分通風。

ex.en: Are you adequately prepared for the interview?
ex.zh: 你面試準備得夠充分嗎？

adequately.en: in a way that is good enough

ex.en: How about adding a little bit more salt?
ex.zh: 再加一點鹽怎麼樣？

ex.en: All these things serve to add to our happiness.
ex.zh: 這些都能為我們增添幸福。

ex.en: Please add my name to the list.
ex.zh: 請把我的名字加到名單上。

add.en: to put something with another thing

ex.en: If you add 3 to 3, you get 6.
ex.zh: 三加三等於六。

ex.en: Please add up all the numbers.
ex.zh: 請把所有數字加總起來。

add.en: to put numbers together to get a total

ex.en: He added that the meeting would be short.
ex.zh: 他補充說會議時間不會太長。

ex.en: I'd like to add one more point.
ex.zh: 我想再補充一點。

ex.en: May I ask you for your name and address?
ex.zh: 可以請問您的姓名和地址嗎？

ex.en: If I knew his address, I could write to him.
ex.zh: 如果我知道他的地址，就能寫信給他了。

ex.en: Please send it to my email address.
ex.zh: 請寄到我的電子郵件信箱。

address.en: the details of where someone lives or where messages are sent

ex.en: We need to address this problem right away.
ex.zh: 我們需要馬上處理這個問題。

ex.en: The new policy addresses customer complaints.
ex.zh: 新政策針對顧客的抱怨提出了解決方式。

address.en: to start to deal with a problem

address.zh: 在（信件）寫上收件地址、寄給

ex.en: This letter is addressed to you.
ex.zh: 這封信是寫給你的。

ex.en: This letter is wrongly addressed.
ex.zh: 這封信的地址寫錯了。

address.en: to write the name and place of the person it is going to on a letter

ex.en: The CEO will address the staff tomorrow.
ex.zh: 執行長明天將對員工發表談話。

ex.en: She addressed the audience in English.
ex.zh: 她用英文向聽眾致詞。

address.en: to make a formal speech to a person or group

ex.en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
ex.zh: 天氣很冷，而且風也很大。

ex.en: In addition to English, he can speak French.
ex.zh: 除了英語，他還會說法語。

addition.en: used to add another thing to what has been said

ex.en: We are expecting an addition to our family.
ex.zh: 我們家快要添新成員了。

ex.en: The new gym is a great addition to the office.
ex.zh: 新健身房讓辦公室增色不少。

addition.en: a person or thing that is added to a group

ex.en: My boy can't do addition properly yet.
ex.zh: 我兒子還不太會做加法。

ex.en: Addition and subtraction are easy for her.
ex.zh: 加法和減法對她來說很簡單。

addition.en: the process of putting numbers together

ex.en: What are the advantages and drawbacks of this method?
ex.zh: 這個方法有什麼優缺點？

ex.en: You have the advantage of a good education.
ex.zh: 你受過良好教育，這是你的優勢。

ex.en: Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
ex.zh: 有駕照是應徵這份工作的加分條件。

advantage.en: something good that helps you do better than others

ex.en: You should take advantage of this opportunity.
ex.zh: 你應該好好利用這個機會。

ex.en: Don't let people take advantage of you.
ex.zh: 別讓人佔你便宜。

advantage.en: to use a chance well, or to use someone unfairly

ex.en: Please book your tickets in advance.
ex.zh: 請事先訂票。

ex.en: Thank you in advance for your help.
ex.zh: 先謝謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: The recent advances in medicine are remarkable.
ex.zh: 醫學最近的進展非常顯著。

ex.en: Advances in technology have changed the way we work.
ex.zh: 科技進步改變了我們的工作方式。

advance.en: a new development that makes things better

ex.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
ex.zh: 我不確定該前進還是後退。

ex.en: Our plans are to advance toward the city.
ex.zh: 我們的計畫是朝城市推進。

ex.en: We require advance payment for large orders.
ex.zh: 大量訂單需要預先付款。

ex.en: No advance booking is needed.
ex.zh: 不需要事先預約。

advance.en: done or given before the usual or expected time

ex.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.
ex.zh: 小孩的體溫通常比大人高。

ex.en: Sometimes adults behave like children.
ex.zh: 有時候大人的行為就像小孩一樣。

adult.en: a person who has grown up and is no longer a child

ex.en: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩張到倫敦的成人票和三張兒童票。

ex.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
ex.zh: 69% 的美國成年人過重或肥胖。

adult.en: fully grown or meant for grown-up people

ex.en: Tom has admitted that he was there that night.
ex.zh: 湯姆承認那天晚上他在那裡。

ex.en: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.
ex.zh: 你能承認自己錯了，真有度量。

ex.en: I admit that I made a mistake.
ex.zh: 我承認我犯了錯。

admit.en: to say that something is true, often unwillingly

ex.en: Three Chinese students were admitted to the college.
ex.zh: 有三名中國學生被那所大學錄取了。

ex.en: He was admitted to the hospital last night.
ex.zh: 他昨晚住院了。

admit.en: to allow a person to enter a school, club or hospital

ex.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
ex.zh: 你聽她的建議是明智的。

ex.en: If you take my advice, you'll see a doctor.
ex.zh: 如果你聽我的建議，就去看醫生吧。

ex.en: I was able to succeed because of your advice.
ex.zh: 因為有你的建議，我才能成功。

advice.en: an opinion about what someone should do

ex.en: She works in hospital administration.
ex.zh: 她在醫院做行政工作。

ex.en: The administration office is on the second floor.
ex.zh: 行政辦公室在二樓。

administration.en: the work of running a company or organization

ex.en: The new administration promised to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 新政府承諾要減稅。

ex.en: The administration will announce its plan next week.
ex.zh: 政府當局下週會公布計畫。

administration.en: the group of people who run a country at a given time

ex.en: We decided to stay an additional day.
ex.zh: 我們決定多待一天。

ex.en: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
ex.zh: 因此必須進行額外的測試，以確保完全安全。

ex.en: Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.
ex.zh: 購買新裝置的顧客可享有額外的試用期優惠。

additional.en: more than what was already there

ex.en: We advertise our products on TV.
ex.zh: 我們在電視上宣傳我們的產品。

ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 那家公司花很多錢在廣告上。

ex.en: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.
ex.zh: 很多網站靠廣告收入維持。

advertise.en: to tell the public about a product to make them want it

ex.en: I advertised my house in the newspaper.
ex.zh: 我在報紙上刊登房子的廣告。

ex.en: I advertised my car for sale.
ex.zh: 我登廣告要賣我的車。

ex.en: The company is advertising for a new secretary.
ex.zh: 公司正在登廣告徵求新秘書。

advertise.en: to put a notice in public to sell something or find someone

ex.en: Tom was hoping the committee would adopt his proposal.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望委員會採納他的提案。

ex.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
ex.zh: 德國在 1880 年代採行了社會保障制度。

ex.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.
ex.zh: 我認為我們最好採用他的計畫。

adopt.en: to start using an idea, plan or method

ex.en: They adopted the little girl.
ex.zh: 他們收養了那個小女孩。

ex.en: We adopted a child.
ex.zh: 我們領養了一個孩子。

ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
ex.zh: 如果不能生小孩，你還可以領養。

adopt.en: to legally take a child into your family

ex.en: There are too many ads on YouTube.
ex.zh: YouTube 上的廣告太多了。

ex.en: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.
ex.zh: 這則分類廣告徵求女歌手組成無伴奏合唱團。

ex.en: I saw your ad for the job online.
ex.zh: 我在網路上看到你們的徵才廣告。

ad.en: a short notice or film that tells people about a product

ex.en: You had better do as the doctor advised you.
ex.zh: 你最好照醫生的建議去做。

ex.en: Tom advised him not to buy the secondhand car.
ex.zh: 湯姆勸他別買那輛二手車。

ex.en: What do you advise me to do?
ex.zh: 您建議我怎麼做？

advise.en: to tell someone what you think they should do

ex.en: Please advise us of any changes to your schedule.
ex.zh: 如果您的行程有任何變動，請通知我們。

ex.en: Passengers are advised that the flight will be delayed.
ex.zh: 旅客請注意，本班機將會延誤。

advise.en: to officially tell someone about something

ex.en: She is a financial adviser at a bank.
ex.zh: 她是銀行的理財顧問。

ex.en: The president met with his advisers this morning.
ex.zh: 總統今天早上和他的顧問們開會。

ex.en: Talk to your academic adviser before choosing courses.
ex.zh: 選課前先和你的指導老師談談。

adviser.en: a person who gives expert advice or helps students

ex.en: You can adjust the seat height with this lever.
ex.zh: 你可以用這根桿子調整座椅高度。

ex.en: We adjusted our prices to stay competitive.
ex.zh: 我們調整了價格以維持競爭力。

adjust.en: to change something slightly to make it work better

ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
ex.zh: 我們的眼睛需要時間適應黑暗。

ex.en: I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
ex.zh: 我正慢慢適應這裡嚴酷的氣候。

adjust.en: to get used to a new situation

ex.en: He advocated the reduction of taxes.
ex.zh: 他提倡減稅。

ex.en: Doctors advocate regular exercise for everyone.
ex.zh: 醫生提倡每個人都要規律運動。

advocate.en: to publicly support an idea or plan

ex.en: She is a strong advocate of equal pay.
ex.zh: 她大力提倡同工同酬。

ex.en: He has long been an advocate for clean energy.
ex.zh: 他長期以來一直倡導乾淨能源。

advocate.en: a person who publicly supports an idea or plan

ex.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.
ex.zh: 我只是故意唱反調而已。

ex.en: Let me play devil's advocate for a moment.
ex.zh: 讓我暫時唱個反調。

advocate.en: to argue against an idea just to test it

ex.en: I can't help admiring his talent.
ex.zh: 我不禁佩服他的才華。

ex.en: I wholeheartedly admire your understanding of Chinese.
ex.zh: 我真心佩服你的中文程度。

ex.en: I admire her for her honesty.
ex.zh: 我欽佩她的誠實。

admire.en: to respect and like someone for what they are or do

ex.en: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗手牽著手，一起欣賞風景。

ex.en: We admired the beauty of the scenery.
ex.zh: 我們欣賞著美麗的景色。

admire.en: to look at something with pleasure

ex.en: We need not only adequate water but clean water.
ex.zh: 我們不僅需要充足的水，還需要乾淨的水。

ex.en: This meal is adequate for three.
ex.zh: 這頓飯夠三個人吃。

ex.en: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前一定要有充足的睡眠。

ex.en: His work was adequate but not excellent.
ex.zh: 他的工作表現還可以，但不算出色。

ex.en: The hotel room was adequate for one night.
ex.zh: 這間飯店房間住一晚還過得去。

adequate.en: good enough but not very good

ex.en: Some plants cannot adapt themselves to the cold.
ex.zh: 有些植物無法適應寒冷。

ex.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
ex.zh: 人類適應環境變化的能力很強。

ex.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
ex.zh: 我適應新環境很慢。

adapt.en: to change so that you can live well in a new situation

ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
ex.zh: 我把車庫改造成工作室。

ex.en: The novel was adapted into a movie.
ex.zh: 這本小說被改編成電影。

adapt.en: to change something so that it can be used in a new way

ex.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
ex.zh: 他寫了一本關於叢林冒險的書。

ex.en: He has an innate love of adventure.
ex.zh: 他天生就熱愛冒險。

ex.en: Gulliver traveled in quest of adventure.
ex.zh: 格列佛為了尋求冒險而去旅行。

adventure.en: an exciting experience that may be dangerous

ex.en: We made a few adjustments to the schedule.
ex.zh: 我們對時程做了一些調整。

ex.en: The seat needs a small adjustment.
ex.zh: 座椅需要稍微調整一下。

adjustment.en: a small change made to improve something

ex.en: Moving to a new country requires some adjustment.
ex.zh: 搬到新國家需要一段時間適應。

ex.en: The adjustment to my new job was harder than expected.
ex.zh: 適應新工作比我想像的困難。

adjustment.en: the process of getting used to a new situation

ex.en: The movie is an adaptation of a popular novel.
ex.zh: 這部電影改編自一本暢銷小說。

ex.en: I prefer the original book to the film adaptation.
ex.zh: 比起改編電影，我比較喜歡原著小說。

adaptation.en: a book or play that has been changed into another form

ex.en: Adaptation to a new culture takes time.
ex.zh: 適應新文化需要時間。

ex.en: This plant shows remarkable adaptation to dry climates.
ex.zh: 這種植物對乾燥氣候展現出驚人的適應力。

adaptation.en: the process of changing to fit a new situation

adaptive.zh: 適應的、能適應的；適性化的

ex.en: Successful companies are adaptive to change.
ex.zh: 成功的企業能適應變化。

ex.en: The app uses adaptive learning to match your level.
ex.zh: 這款 App 採用適性化學習，配合你的程度。

adaptive.en: able to change to fit new conditions

ex.en: The book is written for adolescents.
ex.zh: 這本書是為青少年寫的。

ex.en: Many adolescents spend hours on their phones.
ex.zh: 很多青少年每天花好幾個小時滑手機。

adolescent.en: a young person who is no longer a child but not yet an adult

ex.en: Adolescent boys often grow very quickly.
ex.zh: 青春期的男孩通常長得很快。

ex.en: She works with adolescent patients.
ex.zh: 她負責青少年病患。

adolescent.en: of the time when a child is growing into an adult

ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 那家公司在廣告上花了很多錢。

ex.en: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.
ex.zh: 許多網站靠廣告收入維持營運。

ex.en: He works for an advertising agency.
ex.zh: 他在一家廣告公司上班。

advertising.en: the business of telling the public about products to sell them

ex.en: She showed admirable courage during the crisis.
ex.zh: 她在危機中展現了令人欽佩的勇氣。

ex.en: His honesty is admirable.
ex.zh: 他的誠實令人欽佩。

ex.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.
ex.zh: 我很欽佩他的慷慨大方。

ex.en: All of a sudden I'm filled with great admiration for you!
ex.zh: 我瞬間對你肅然起敬！

ex.en: I feel admiration for his talent.
ex.zh: 我很欽佩他的才幹。

admiration.en: a feeling of respect and liking for someone

ex.en: Many teenagers argue more with their parents during adolescence.
ex.zh: 許多青少年在青春期和父母的爭吵會變多。

ex.en: She made lifelong friends during her adolescence.
ex.zh: 她在青春期交到了一輩子的朋友。

adolescence.en: the time when a child is growing into an adult

ex.en: If you want to sell your old sofa, why not put an advertisement in the local paper?
ex.zh: 如果你想賣掉舊沙發，何不在本地報紙上登個廣告？

ex.en: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
ex.zh: 廣告慫恿我們購買奢侈品。

ex.en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
ex.zh: 我們的徵人廣告已經收到很多應徵申請。

advertisement.en: a notice or film that tells people about a product or job

ex.en: Check the addressee before sending the package.
ex.zh: 寄出包裹前請確認收件人。

ex.en: The addressee was listed incorrectly on the envelope.
ex.zh: 信封上的收件人資料列錯了。

addressee.en: the person that a letter or package is sent to

ex.en: The insurance adjuster inspected the flooded apartment.
ex.zh: 保險理賠調查員檢查了淹水的公寓。

ex.en: An adjuster will review the damage before the claim is approved.
ex.zh: 理賠核准前，理算人員會先審查損害情況。

adjuster.en: a person who checks damage and decides how much an insurance company pays

ex.en: The post office is adjacent to the library.
ex.zh: 郵局在圖書館旁邊。

ex.en: The living room is adjacent to the dining room.
ex.zh: 客廳緊鄰著餐廳。

ex.en: The stadium is adjacent to the school.
ex.zh: 體育館緊鄰學校。

adjacent.en: next to or very near something

ex.en: The admission is ten dollars a person.
ex.zh: 入場費一個人 10 美元。

ex.en: Admission to the museum is thirty dollars.
ex.zh: 博物館入場費是三十美元。

ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
ex.zh: 五歲以下兒童免收入場費。

admission.en: permission to enter a place, or the money paid for it

ex.en: She made out the application for admission.
ex.zh: 她填好了入學申請表。

ex.en: She received admission to a top university.
ex.zh: 她獲得一所頂尖大學的入學許可。

admission.en: permission to join a school or university

ex.en: He made an admission that he had lied.
ex.zh: 他承認他撒謊了。

ex.en: His silence was an admission of guilt.
ex.zh: 他的沉默等於承認了自己有錯。

admission.en: a statement that you have done something wrong or that something is true

ex.en: The meeting was adjourned until Friday.
ex.zh: 會議延到星期五再繼續。

ex.en: Let's adjourn for lunch and continue at two.
ex.zh: 我們先休會吃午餐，兩點再繼續。

adjourn.en: to stop a meeting for a short time and continue later

ex.en: She is taking an advanced English course.
ex.zh: 她正在上高級英文課程。

ex.en: The hospital uses advanced technology to treat patients.
ex.zh: 這間醫院使用先進的技術來治療病人。

ex.en: In the Bible, Adam is the first man.
ex.zh: 在聖經中，亞當是第一個人。

ex.en: Adam is also a common name for boys today.
ex.zh: 亞當在今天也是很常見的男孩名字。

ex.en: She added some salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 她在湯裡加了一些鹽。

ex.en: They added two new rooms to the house.
ex.zh: 他們為房子增建了兩間新房間。

ex.en: "I'll be late," he added quietly.
ex.zh: 他又輕聲補了一句：「我會晚到。」

ex.en: She added that the meeting would start at ten.
ex.zh: 她補充說會議十點開始。

ex.en: The hotel charges no added fee for breakfast.
ex.zh: 這間旅館的早餐不另外收費。

ex.en: Fresh fruit juice has no added sugar.
ex.zh: 新鮮果汁沒有額外添加糖。

ex.en: Her advocacy for clean water helped many villages.
ex.zh: 她對乾淨水源的倡導幫助了許多村莊。

ex.en: The group is known for its advocacy of animal rights.
ex.zh: 這個團體以倡導動物權利聞名。

ex.en: Strong advocacy by parents led to a new school library.
ex.zh: 家長們的積極倡導促成了一座新的學校圖書館。

ex.en: Addiction to sugar can be hard to break.
ex.zh: 對糖的上癮很難戒掉。

ex.en: The clinic helps people overcome drug addiction.
ex.zh: 這間診所協助人們戒除毒癮。

ex.en: His addiction to video games affected his grades.
ex.zh: 他沉迷電玩，影響了成績。

ex.en: Her addiction to her phone worries her parents.
ex.zh: 她沉迷手機，讓父母很擔心。

ex.en: 'Beautiful' is an adjective that describes a noun.
ex.zh: 「beautiful」是用來修飾名詞的形容詞。

ex.en: Choose the correct adjective to complete the sentence.
ex.zh: 請選出正確的形容詞來完成句子。

ex.en: The teacher explained the adjective form of the word.
ex.zh: 老師解釋了這個字的形容詞形式。

ex.en: This is an adjective clause that gives more information about the noun.
ex.zh: 這是一個形容詞子句，提供該名詞更多資訊。

ex.en: He is a coffee addict who can't work without a cup.
ex.zh: 他是個咖啡成癮者，沒喝一杯就沒辦法工作。

ex.en: The clinic helps every addict who asks for support.
ex.zh: 這間診所幫助每一位尋求支持的成癮者。

ex.en: My brother is a game addict and plays all weekend.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是個遊戲迷，整個週末都在玩。

ex.en: I saw an advert for the new phone on the bus.
ex.zh: 我在公車上看到那款新手機的廣告。

ex.en: The company put an advert in the local newspaper.
ex.zh: 那家公司在地方報紙上刊登了廣告。

ex.en: This advert is so funny that I remember it.
ex.zh: 這則廣告太好笑了，所以我記得它。

ex.en: The advent of the internet changed how we shop.
ex.zh: 網路的出現改變了我們購物的方式。

ex.en: With the advent of spring, the park filled with people.
ex.zh: 隨著春天的來臨，公園裡擠滿了人。

ex.en: The admiral gave orders to the whole fleet.
ex.zh: 海軍上將對整支艦隊下達了命令。

ex.en: He rose to the rank of admiral after thirty years at sea.
ex.zh: 在海上服役三十年後，他晉升為海軍上將。

ex.en: Admittedly, the plan is not perfect, but it is a good start.
ex.zh: 誠然這個計畫並不完美，但是個不錯的開始。

ex.en: The food was admittedly a bit expensive, yet it was worth it.
ex.zh: 這些食物的確有點貴，但很值得。

ex.en: The two teams have been fierce adversaries for years.
ex.zh: 這兩支球隊多年來一直是激烈的對手。

ex.en: He treated his old adversary with respect after the match.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，他尊重地對待昔日的對手。

ex.en: I adore this little cafe near my house.
ex.zh: 我超愛我家附近這間小咖啡館。

ex.en: She adores her new puppy.
ex.zh: 她非常疼愛她的新小狗。

ex.en: The children adore their grandfather.
ex.zh: 孩子們非常敬愛他們的祖父。

ex.en: Fans adored the singer and waited hours to see her.
ex.zh: 粉絲們愛慕那位歌手，並等了好幾個小時只為見她一面。

ex.en: Many habits we form in childhood continue into adulthood.
ex.zh: 我們在童年養成的許多習慣會延續到成年。

ex.en: He reached adulthood and moved out of his parents' home.
ex.zh: 他成年後搬出了父母的家。

ex.en: They adorn the streets with lights every winter.
ex.zh: 每年冬天他們都用燈飾點綴街道。

ex.en: Flowers adorned the table for the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚禮的餐桌上擺滿了花朵作裝飾。

ex.en: She likes to adorn her hair with colorful ribbons.
ex.zh: 她喜歡用彩色緞帶裝飾頭髮。

ex.en: This mobile game is so addictive that I played for hours.
ex.zh: 這款手機遊戲太容易上癮，我玩了好幾個小時。

ex.en: Nicotine is highly addictive, which is why quitting smoking is hard.
ex.zh: 尼古丁極容易使人上癮，所以戒菸很難。

ex.en: The young adventurer sailed alone across the sea.
ex.zh: 這位年輕的冒險家獨自航行橫越大海。

ex.en: As a true adventurer, he loves exploring unknown places.
ex.zh: 他是個真正的冒險家，喜歡探索未知的地方。

ex.en: She is an adventurous girl who loves hiking alone.
ex.zh: 她是個愛冒險的女孩，喜歡獨自健行。

ex.en: Try something adventurous, like eating a new dish.
ex.zh: 試試一些有冒險精神的事，像是吃一道沒吃過的菜。

ex.en: We booked two adjoining rooms for the family.
ex.zh: 我們為家人訂了兩間相鄰的房間。

ex.en: The kitchen has an adjoining dining area.
ex.zh: 廚房旁邊緊鄰著用餐區。

ex.en: The farmer bought the adjoining field.
ex.zh: 農夫買下了隔壁相連的那塊田。

ex.en: She is a great admirer of Marie Curie.
ex.zh: 她非常欽佩居禮夫人。

ex.en: The author has many admirers around the world.
ex.zh: 這位作家在世界各地有許多仰慕者。

ex.en: A secret admirer sent her flowers.
ex.zh: 一位神祕的追求者送了她花。

ex.en: He turned out to be her admirer from college.
ex.zh: 他原來是她大學時期的追求者。

ex.en: The army was advancing slowly across the field.
ex.zh: 軍隊正緩緩穿越原野前進。

ex.en: Technology is advancing faster than ever.
ex.zh: 科技的進步比以往任何時候都快。

ex.en: She is advancing in her career at a steady pace.
ex.zh: 她的事業正穩定地向前發展。

ex.en: She was adamant that she would not sell the house.
ex.zh: 她堅決表示不會賣掉那棟房子。

ex.en: He remained adamant despite all our arguments.
ex.zh: 儘管我們百般勸說，他仍然態度堅決。

ex.en: Strict adherence to the rules is required.
ex.zh: 必須嚴格遵守規定。

ex.en: His adherence to old habits made change difficult.
ex.zh: 他對舊習慣的堅持讓改變變得困難。

ex.en: Living near the station is advantageous for commuters.
ex.zh: 住在車站附近對通勤者很有利。

ex.en: The deal was advantageous to both companies.
ex.zh: 這筆交易對兩家公司都有利。

ex.en: This chair has an adjustable height.
ex.zh: 這張椅子的高度可以調整。

ex.en: The bag comes with an adjustable strap.
ex.zh: 這個包包附有可調節的背帶。

ex.en: Heavy traffic can adversely affect people's health.
ex.zh: 嚴重的交通壅塞可能對人們的健康造成不良影響。

ex.en: The long drought adversely affected the harvest.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱對收成造成了不利影響。

ex.en: She is adept at solving difficult math problems.
ex.zh: 她很擅長解決困難的數學題。

ex.en: He became adept at fixing bicycles after years of practice.
ex.zh: 練習多年後，他變得很擅長修腳踏車。

ex.en: She is an adept at chess and rarely loses.
ex.zh: 她是西洋棋高手，很少輸棋。

ex.en: The workshop was full of adepts who shared their tricks.
ex.zh: 工作坊裡滿是分享訣竅的內行人。

ex.en: Adrenaline rushed through him as the roller coaster dropped.
ex.zh: 雲霄飛車俯衝時，他全身腎上腺素飆升。

ex.en: The body releases adrenaline when we feel scared.
ex.zh: 我們感到害怕時，身體會分泌腎上腺素。

ex.en: They have an adopted daughter from another country.
ex.zh: 他們有一個來自外國的養女。

ex.en: She feels at home in her adopted city.
ex.zh: 她在自己選定落腳的城市感到很自在。

ex.en: The adopted plan was cheaper than the original one.
ex.zh: 採用的方案比原本的便宜。

ex.en: She loves her adoptive parents very much.
ex.zh: 她非常愛她的養父母。

ex.en: The adoptive family welcomed the child warmly.
ex.zh: 收養家庭熱情地迎接了這個孩子。

ex.en: The adhesion between the tape and the wall was weak.
ex.zh: 膠帶和牆面之間的黏著力很弱。

ex.en: Good adhesion is important when you paint a metal surface.
ex.zh: 在金屬表面上漆時，良好的附著力很重要。

ex.en: The old law treated adultery as a crime.
ex.zh: 舊法律把通姦視為犯罪。

ex.en: The couple divorced after he admitted to adultery.
ex.zh: 他承認外遇後，兩人就離婚了。

ex.en: Our garden adjoins the neighbor's yard.
ex.zh: 我們的花園和鄰居的院子相鄰。

ex.en: The kitchen adjoins the dining room.
ex.zh: 廚房和飯廳相連。

ex.en: She showed great courage in the face of adversity.
ex.zh: 她在逆境中展現出極大的勇氣。

ex.en: Adversity taught him to be strong.
ex.zh: 逆境教會了他堅強。

ex.en: Adrenalin rushed through her body before the race.
ex.zh: 比賽前，腎上腺素在她體內奔流。

ex.en: Fear makes your body release adrenalin.
ex.zh: 恐懼會使身體分泌腎上腺素。

ex.en: The app is a useful adjunct to the textbook.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式是教科書的有用輔助工具。

ex.en: Music is not just an adjunct to the film; it tells the story.
ex.zh: 音樂不只是電影的附屬品，它也在說故事。

ex.en: She teaches as an adjunct professor at the college.
ex.zh: 她在這所學院擔任兼任教授。

ex.en: The hospital has an adjunct clinic next door.
ex.zh: 醫院隔壁有一間附屬診所。

ex.en: The teacher admonished the students for talking in class.
ex.zh: 老師告誡學生上課不要說話。

ex.en: She admonished him to drive more carefully.
ex.zh: 她告誡他開車要更小心。

ex.en: The committee questioned the adequacy of the safety rules.
ex.zh: 委員會質疑安全規定是否足夠。

ex.en: We tested the adequacy of the food supply for the trip.
ex.zh: 我們檢驗了旅行糧食的充足程度。

ex.en: He is a loyal adherent of the local football club.
ex.zh: 他是當地足球隊忠實的擁護者。

ex.en: Adherents of the faith gathered in the square.
ex.zh: 信徒們聚集在廣場上。

ex.en: The sticker has an adherent backing that sticks to any surface.
ex.zh: 這張貼紙背面有黏性，可貼在任何表面上。

ex.en: Dirt was adherent to the bottom of his shoes.
ex.zh: 他的鞋底黏著泥土。

ex.en: The Admiralty once controlled the British navy.
ex.zh: 海軍部曾經掌管英國海軍。

ex.en: Officers from the admiralty reviewed the new ship designs.
ex.zh: 海軍部的軍官審查了新的船艦設計。

ex.en: This juice contains no artificial additives.
ex.zh: 這款果汁不含人工添加物。

ex.en: A small additive can make the paint dry faster.
ex.zh: 一點點添加劑就能讓油漆乾得更快。

ex.en: The effect of the two medicines is additive, so be careful.
ex.zh: 這兩種藥的效果會累加，所以要小心。

ex.en: Additive colors are made by mixing different lights.
ex.zh: 加色是由混合不同色光產生的。

ex.en: The puppy looked adorable in its tiny red sweater.
ex.zh: 小狗穿著紅色小毛衣看起來好可愛。

ex.en: What an adorable baby!
ex.zh: 多麼討人喜歡的寶寶啊！

ex.en: You need a plug adaptor when you travel to another country.
ex.zh: 去別的國家旅行時，你需要一個插頭轉接器。

ex.en: I lost the adaptor for my laptop charger.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了筆電充電器的轉接頭。

ex.en: The adaptor of the novel changed the ending for the stage play.
ex.zh: 這部小說的改編者為舞台劇更動了結局。

ex.en: As an adaptor, she turns books into screenplays.
ex.zh: 身為改編者，她把書改寫成劇本。

ex.en: Use a strong adhesive to fix the broken cup.
ex.zh: 用強力膠來修補破掉的杯子。

ex.en: The label peeled off because the adhesive was old.
ex.zh: 因為黏膠老化了，標籤脫落了。

ex.en: An adhesive bandage covered the small cut.
ex.zh: 一片黏性繃帶蓋住了小傷口。

ex.en: The back of the sticker is adhesive.
ex.zh: 貼紙的背面是有黏性的。

ex.en: The dispute was sent to adjudication by an independent panel.
ex.zh: 這項爭議被交由獨立小組裁決。

ex.en: We are still waiting for the court's final adjudication.
ex.zh: 我們仍在等待法院的最終判決。

ex.en: She handled the difficult situation admirably.
ex.zh: 她把這個困難的局面處理得令人欽佩。

ex.en: The young team performed admirably under pressure.
ex.zh: 這支年輕的隊伍在壓力下表現出色。

ex.en: The little boat was left adrift on the open sea.
ex.zh: 那艘小船被丟在大海上漂流。

ex.en: After the storm, the raft floated adrift for days.
ex.zh: 暴風雨之後，木筏漂流了好幾天。

ex.en: Without a plan, she felt adrift after graduation.
ex.zh: 沒有計畫的她，在畢業後覺得茫然失措。

ex.en: The ship was adrift with its engine broken.
ex.zh: 那艘船引擎壞了，隨波漂流。

ex.en: Kids are usually very adaptable to new schools.
ex.zh: 孩子通常很能適應新學校。

ex.en: This adaptable recipe works with any vegetable.
ex.zh: 這份食譜可以靈活搭配任何蔬菜。

ex.en: The admiring crowd clapped for the young pianist.
ex.zh: 讚賞的觀眾為年輕鋼琴家鼓掌。

ex.en: She gave him an admiring glance across the room.
ex.zh: 她從房間另一頭投以欽佩的一瞥。

ex.en: He ignored his doctor's admonition to rest.
ex.zh: 他無視醫生要他休息的告誡。

ex.en: The sign carries an admonition against littering.
ex.zh: 這個告示牌勸告人們不要亂丟垃圾。

ex.en: She adjusted the seat before driving.
ex.zh: 她開車前調整了座椅。

ex.en: He quickly adjusted to the new school.
ex.zh: 他很快就適應了新學校。

ex.en: The adjusted price is lower than before.
ex.zh: 調整後的價格比之前低。

ex.en: The adjusted schedule gives us more time.
ex.zh: 調整過的時程給了我們更多時間。

ex.en: Many old houses in the desert are built of adobe.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡許多老房子是用土磚蓋的。

ex.en: The thick adobe walls keep the house cool in summer.
ex.zh: 厚厚的土磚牆讓房子夏天保持涼爽。

ex.en: The two lawyers had an adversarial relationship.
ex.zh: 這兩位律師之間是對立的關係。

ex.en: An adversarial style of debate can make people defensive.
ex.zh: 對抗式的辯論風格可能讓人變得防備。

ex.en: Adelaide is a city in South Australia.
ex.zh: 阿德萊德是南澳大利亞州的一座城市。

ex.en: We flew from Sydney to Adelaide for the weekend.
ex.zh: 我們從雪梨飛到阿德萊德度週末。

ex.en: She adamantly refused to change her mind.
ex.zh: 她堅決不肯改變主意。

ex.en: He adamantly denied taking the money.
ex.zh: 他堅決否認拿了那筆錢。

ex.en: The old adage says that practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 老話說得好，熟能生巧。

ex.en: My grandfather often repeated the adage about early birds.
ex.zh: 我爺爺常常重複那句關於早起鳥兒的諺語。

ex.en: Adaptability is important when you move to a new country.
ex.zh: 搬到新國家時，適應力很重要。

ex.en: Her adaptability helped her learn the new job quickly.
ex.zh: 她的適應力讓她很快學會新工作。

ex.en: The fans looked at the singer with adoration.
ex.zh: 歌迷們滿懷愛慕地望著那位歌手。

ex.en: Her adoration for her grandmother never faded.
ex.zh: 她對祖母的敬愛從未減退。

ex.en: The lawyer adduced new evidence to support her case.
ex.zh: 律師提出新證據來支持她的主張。

ex.en: He adduced several examples to prove his point.
ex.zh: 他舉出幾個例子來證明自己的論點。

ex.en: The judge announced an adjournment until Monday.
ex.zh: 法官宣布休庭到星期一。

ex.en: The adjournment of the meeting gave us time to think.
ex.zh: 會議暫停讓我們有時間思考。

ex.en: The judge ruled that the photo was admissible as evidence.
ex.zh: 法官裁定這張照片可作為證據。

ex.en: Only admissible questions may be asked in court.
ex.zh: 在法庭上只能提出可被接受的問題。

ex.en: We spent our holiday on the Adriatic coast of Croatia.
ex.zh: 我們在克羅埃西亞的亞得里亞海岸度假。

ex.en: The Adriatic Sea lies between Italy and the Balkan Peninsula.
ex.zh: 亞得里亞海位於義大利與巴爾幹半島之間。

ex.en: The singer waved to her adoring fans outside the hall.
ex.zh: 歌手向會場外崇拜她的粉絲揮手。

ex.en: He gave his daughter an adoring smile as she took her first steps.
ex.zh: 女兒邁出第一步時，他滿懷愛意地對她微笑。

ex.en: Aden is a port city in Yemen.
ex.zh: 亞丁是葉門的一座港口城市。

ex.en: Ships have stopped at Aden for centuries.
ex.zh: 幾個世紀以來，船隻一直在亞丁停靠。

ex.en: The adjudicator announced the winner of the contest.
ex.zh: 評審宣布了比賽的優勝者。

ex.en: An independent adjudicator settled the dispute.
ex.zh: 一位獨立的裁決人解決了這場爭議。

ex.en: He felt better after admitting that he had made a mistake.
ex.zh: 承認自己犯了錯之後，他覺得好多了。

ex.en: She kept admitting new students into the class all week.
ex.zh: 她整個星期不斷讓新學生加入這個班級。

ex.en: In the sentence, "quickly" is an adverb.
ex.zh: 在這個句子裡，quickly 是副詞。

ex.en: An adverb can describe a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
ex.zh: 副詞可以修飾動詞、形容詞或另一個副詞。

ex.en: The general's adjutant handled his schedule and letters.
ex.zh: 將軍的副官負責處理他的行程和信件。

ex.en: The adjutant read the orders to the officers.
ex.zh: 副官向軍官們宣讀命令。

ex.en: Konrad Adenauer was the first chancellor of West Germany after World War II.
ex.zh: 康拉德·阿登納是二戰後西德的第一任總理。

ex.en: Adenauer led the German government throughout the 1950s.
ex.zh: 阿登納在整個一九五○年代領導德國政府。

ex.en: A neutral judge will adjudicate the dispute between the two companies.
ex.zh: 一位中立的法官將裁決這兩家公司之間的爭議。

ex.en: She was asked to adjudicate the school's writing contest.
ex.zh: 她受邀擔任學校寫作比賽的評審。

ex.en: The room had little adornment except for a single painting.
ex.zh: 這個房間除了一幅畫之外幾乎沒有裝飾。

ex.en: She wore a flower as an adornment in her hair.
ex.zh: 她把一朵花別在頭髮上當裝飾。

ex.en: The singer enjoyed the adulation of his fans.
ex.zh: 這位歌手享受著粉絲的狂熱追捧。

ex.en: Too much adulation can make a person arrogant.
ex.zh: 過多的吹捧會讓人變得自大。

ex.en: After much ado, they finally found the lost keys.
ex.zh: 一陣忙亂之後，他們終於找到了遺失的鑰匙。

ex.en: Without further ado, let's start the show.
ex.zh: 不再多說廢話，我們開始表演吧。

ex.en: The court will adjudge him guilty only if the evidence is clear.
ex.zh: 只有在證據明確時，法院才會裁定他有罪。

ex.en: The panel adjudged her essay the best in the contest.
ex.zh: 評審團裁定她的文章為比賽中最佳。

ex.en: The small costs add up quickly over a whole month.
ex.zh: 小額花費一整個月下來很快就會累積起來。

ex.en: If you add up all the bills, we owe about two thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 把所有帳單加起來，我們大約欠兩千元。

ex.en: Her savings were adding up faster than she had expected.
ex.zh: 她的存款累積得比她預期的還快。

add up.en: to be added together to make a total

ex.en: His story just doesn't add up to me.
ex.zh: 他的說法對我來說就是說不通。

ex.en: The facts did not add up, so the teacher asked again.
ex.zh: 事實對不起來，所以老師又問了一次。

ex.en: Does it add up that he left without saying anything?
ex.zh: 他一聲不響就離開，這合理嗎？

add up.en: to make sense or seem logical

ex.en: All the small costs added up to more than we expected.
ex.zh: 所有的小額費用加起來比我們預期的還多。

ex.en: The bill adds up to fifty dollars for the four of us.
ex.zh: 我們四個人的帳單總共是五十元。

add up to.en: to reach a total of a certain amount

ex.en: Adding more sugar will add to the sweetness of the tea.
ex.zh: 多加點糖會讓茶更甜。

ex.en: The new paint added to the beauty of the old house.
ex.zh: 新油漆讓這棟老房子更漂亮。

add to.en: to increase something or put more of something with it

ex.en: The heavy rain added to our troubles on the road.
ex.zh: 大雨讓我們在路上的麻煩更多了。

ex.en: Losing his keys only added to his stress that morning.
ex.zh: 弄丟鑰匙只是讓他那天早上的壓力更大。

add to.en: to make a bad situation worse

ex.en: He was late, and to add insult to injury, he forgot my gift.
ex.zh: 他遲到了，而且更過分的是還忘了我的禮物。

ex.en: The rain ruined our trip, and the flight delay added insult to injury.
ex.zh: 雨毀了我們的旅行，班機延誤更是雪上加霜。

ex.en: They fired him and, to add insult to injury, took his car.
ex.zh: 他們開除了他，還雪上加霜地收走他的車。

add insult to injury.en: to make a bad situation worse
